incidents.summary: Playtech faces an ongoing defamation lawsuit alleging that its subsidiary commissioned a false report to damage Evolution and concealed its involvement, with the dispute continuing in September 2026.

sources.title: Evolution accuses Playtech of funding 'smear campaign'
sources.quote: Evolution allege that Playtech’s subsidiary, Playtech Software Limited, hired private intelligence firm Black Cube to produce and leak a false report aimed at damaging its business.

sources.title: Evolution accuses Playtech of funding 'smear campaign'
sources.quote: In its latest filing, Evolution added Playtech as a defendant, accusing the company of hiding its role for nearly four years.

sources.title: Playtech's legal spat with rival deepens after publication of secret report
sources.quote: Playtech’s long-running legal feud with rival Evolution has deepened after the gambling software firm claimed a previously-hidden report proved its competitor was “problematic” and made money in banned markets.

positives: Playtech is renewing IT equipment and relocating a substantial portion of its Estonian development centre's server rooms as part of an energy-efficiency upgrade.
